content.comment_body: I'm able to retrieve values from my Modbus slave using Modbus Poll, but not with the [product_name] device even when both configurations match. Any suggestions?
Based on the screenshot you shared, I can't determine if the value appears in [product_name] or not. Try clicking the icon resembling a pair of glasses to check.
Keep in mind that [product_name] applies a +1 offset to addresses. Try reading HR4001 instead.
The +1 offset resolved the issue. Thank you for your assistance.
I'm just beginning to use the [product_name] PLC. Would you be able to share your program as a reference for me?

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants struggled to configure the [product_name] device to read data from a Modbus slave. Although the same configuration worked in Modbus Poll, the difference was that [product_name] uses a +1 offset for Modbus addresses, which is not obvious to new users. Recognizing and applying this offset allowed successful data reads, highlighting the need for clearer documentation and easier usability when setting up Modbus communication.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] device to read Modbus slave values reliably with the same settings that work in Modbus Poll. There is a desire for straightforward configuration and consistency, with minimal unexpected changes.
